verses.text: Ha ix wilani, ichato ay jun ix ix, ix sb'ok'e spat, te wach' ix aj yilji, uke' wal yoyal ix yak'em ix.
Ix smilcham nok' nok' ix, ix sb'o'an jun niwan wa'el ix, ix sb'o'an wino ix te wach', ix sb'o'anb'at ix t'a sat smexa.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' ix t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak ay t'a yol chonhab'.
Haxo heb' schekab' ix chi' ix halan icha tik: Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek. Ex malaj he pensar, kotanhek.
Ol ex wa'ok, ol eyuk'an wino to wach'xo yaji.
Aktejekkan he manh pensaril chi' yik wach' tzalajk'olal ol ex ajok. B'eyb'alejek sb'eyb'al heb' te jelan spensar, xchi heb' schekab' ix chi'. Ha jun ix ix chi', a jelanil sch'oxo'.
Tato tzal t'a heb' b'uchumtak to chuk sk'ulej heb', anhej lolonel manh wach'ok ol yal heb' t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' chuk to manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb', tonhej ol ach sb'aj heb'.
Tato tza kach heb' anima ak'umtak, ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' ay spensar b'ajtil tz'och spalta'il heb', ol ach xajanej heb'.
k'ayb'ej heb' jelan yik wach' ol te jelanb'ok heb'. k'ayb'ej heb' anima wach' spensar yik wach' ol ste ojtakejel heb'.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato skojtakejel Dios to Haxonhej Ochi, tz'akan ko pensar sik'lab'il syal chi'.
Ha yuj jelanil chi', ol najatb'ok ko k 'inal, te tzijtum ab'il ol kila'.
Tato ay ko jelanil, kiknhej yaj wach'ilal. Tato b'uchumtak skutej ko b'a jun, munil t'a kib'anh ol kotkan yahelal.
Ha junok ix ix malaj spensar, manh jantakok slolon ix, max k'ixwilaj jab'ok ix, malaj pax jab'ok tas snachajel yuj ix.
Tonhej tz'em k'ojan ix t'a yol xila, t'a sti' spat cha'anh yajk'e t'a tzalan t'a yol chonhab',
syawtankot heb' tojolnhej tzek' t'a yol b'e chi' ix, syalan ix icha tik:
Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek, xchi ix. Syalanpax ix t'a heb' malaj spensar:
Ha ha ha' tz'elk'aji, te wach' yuk'ji ha'. Ha jab'ok wa'el sko wa t'a elk'altak te wach', xchi ix.
Haxo heb' winh kelemtak chi', manh yojtakok heb' winh tato a heb' winh yawtejnakkot ix, chamnakxo heb' winh tikne'ik.
